scope: Local Docker runtime-to-Logs authorization and byte-preservation scenarios; not a native AWS capture.
handler_source:
import os, sys
print('cold initialization', flush=True)
def handler(event, context):
    print(event['prefix'] + event['text'] * event['repeat'], flush=True)
    sys.stderr.write('stderr:' + event['prefix'] + '\n')
    sys.stderr.flush()
    sys.stdout.write(event.get('partial', ''))
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return {'group': os.environ['AWS_LAMBDA_LOG_GROUP_NAME'], 'stream': os.environ['AWS_LAMBDA_LOG_STREAM_NAME']}
